---
description: How to write math in chat answers and markdown files
---

# Math rendering

Use standard LaTeX delimiters everywhere (chat and `.md` files):

- Inline math: `$...$` — e.g. `$x^2 + y^2$`
- Block/display math: `$$...$$` — e.g.
  ```markdown
  $$
  \dot{x} = y
  $$
  ```

Do not use `\(...\)` / `\[...\]`.
